spec: WHATWG HTML Standard, tree construction algorithm

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.54 DOCTYPE state and §13.2.6.4.1 initial insertion mode
features.semantics: a doctype selects no-quirks mode and is never rendered as text

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.46 comment states
features.semantics: a comment contributes no text nodes

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.72 named character reference state
features.semantics: `&` is decoded to an ampersand character and re-escaped on output

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.78 numeric character reference end state
features.semantics: `A` decodes to the letter A

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.72 named character reference state
features.semantics: an unknown named reference stays literal text

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.5 script data state
features.semantics: script content is raw text and the element carries no document body content

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.2 RCDATA state
features.semantics: textarea content is RCDATA, so `a < b` is text rather than markup

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.33 attribute value (double-quoted) state
features.semantics: a quoted attribute value is preserved verbatim

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.37 attribute value (unquoted) state
features.semantics: an unquoted value is parsed and serialised with quotes

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.35 before attribute name state
features.semantics: a boolean attribute keeps its empty value

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.42 self-closing start tag state
features.semantics:
`
` is a void br and adds no closing tag

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.9 in table insertion mode
features.semantics: rows inside a table without tbody are still table rows

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.9 in table insertion mode
features.semantics: a nested table stays a separate table element with its own cell

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.9 in table insertion mode (foster parenting)
features.semantics: stray text inside a table is moved before the table

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.7 in body insertion mode
features.semantics: a p start tag closes the open p

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.7 in body insertion mode
features.semantics: an li start tag closes the open li

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.7 in body insertion mode (form element pointer)
features.semantics: a nested form start tag is ignored, leaving one form

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.44 CDATA section state
features.semantics: CDATA inside svg is preserved as foreign content

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.33 attribute value (double-quoted) state
features.semantics: a repeated attribute keeps the first value and drops the later one

features.spec: HTML Standard §4.12.3 template element
features.semantics: template contents stay inert and are not rendered inline

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.5.42 self-closing start tag state
features.semantics: `<div/>` is a div start tag, so the following text stays in the document; the content is kept and the IR does not create a block for a semantically neutral container

features.spec: HTML Standard §13.2.6.4.9 in table insertion mode (thead and tbody)
features.semantics: thead cells stay header cells and tbody cells stay data cells
